verses.text: A song for going up to worship. Blessed are all who fear the Lord and live his way.
You will certainly eat what your own hands have provided. Blessings to you! May things go well for you!
Your wife will be like a fruitful vine inside your home. Your children will be like young olive trees around your table.
This is how the Lord will bless the person who fears him.
May the Lord bless you from Zion so that you may see Jerusalem prospering all the days of your life.
May you live to see your children’s children. Let there be peace in Israel!
